feature_definitions_and_encodings.having_IP_Address: -1 if hostname is an IPv4/IPv6 literal; otherwise 1
feature_definitions_and_encodings.URL_Length: 1 if URL length <54; 0 if 54<=length<=75; -1 if length >75
feature_definitions_and_encodings.Shortining_Service: -1 if hostname is a known shortening service; otherwise 1
feature_definitions_and_encodings.having_At_Symbol: -1 if @ occurs in the URL; otherwise 1
feature_definitions_and_encodings.Prefix_Suffix: -1 if hostname contains a hyphen; otherwise 1
feature_definitions_and_encodings.port: -1 if explicit port differs from HTTP/HTTPS default; otherwise 1
feature_definitions_and_encodings.HTTPS_token: -1 if hostname contains the token 'https'; otherwise 1

training_source: Existing cleaned UCI Phishing Websites dataset (dataset 327)
limitations: The UCI table contains pre-extracted feature values but no original URL strings.
The shortened-URL feature uses an explicit offline provider list.
No DNS, WHOIS, TLS certificate, HTTP, webpage, or reputation features are used.
